image_alt: A whippet walks towards the camera along a wide gravel woodland track lined with golden bracken and autumn trees.

text.facebook: The government's fireworks consultation closed on 7 October, and PDSA wants private fireworks limited to licensed public displays. Nothing changes before Bonfire Night, though, and fireworks can legally go off until 11pm on any night. My tip: talk to your vet now if your dog struggles, not on 5 November, and set up a cosy den before the bangs start. How I'm handling walks this season: https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/fireworks-consultation-and-dogs
